stemMd: Which process transfers thermal energy through a vacuum?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Direct contact between adjacent solid particles across the empty gap

explanationMd: Thermal radiation consists of electromagnetic waves and can propagate without a material medium. Conduction and convection require matter. This is why energy from the Sun can cross the near-vacuum of space.

distractorRationale.c: A vacuum has no gas molecules to conduct heat.
distractorRationale.d: A vacuum by itself contains no flowing liquid.
distractorRationale.a: There are no adjacent material particles bridging the vacuum gap.
